name: looks
description: Make Claude Code look the way you like: one-line tool calls, replies centered at a reading width, and four themes (Retro CRT, Punk, Synthwave, Zen paper) switched with /theme.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The theme for new sessions until you pick one with /theme.

toolCalls.title: Tool calls
toolCalls.description: compact draws each tool call as one line (ctrl+o shows them in full); full keeps Claude Code's own rows.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: centered puts prompts, tool calls, and replies in one column at the reading width; left keeps them at the left edge.

readingWidth.title: Reading width
readingWidth.description: The column width, in characters, for centered prompts, tool calls, and replies.
